reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music experience in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat beds now transition smoothly without hard cuts. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a seamless audio experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Enhanced Audio Experience in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce that we've improved the audio experience in Provincia! The transitions between day, night, title, and combat music beds are now seamless, thanks to our new long equal-power self-crossfade system. This means no more jarring cuts in your gameplay. For more information, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
